about: A2, the siege's radio voice (docs/music.md "Siege layers"): KSTR's announcer reads the goal lines (a new goal from the radio's chain, one done) and the canyon news (a wave coming, a wave beaten, a canyon held, a canyon fallen with the Matriarch coming), one line each, under 6 s. The game plays them through its radio-line queue (narration first, never two at once), the text stays on the HUD. Same voice and radio.py as the station's ads. KSTR is written K-S-T-R so it is spelled out. R2 adds the realm projects' lines: one when a project starts, one when it ends (docs/mmorpg-play.md "Realm projects").

entries.text: [bright, upbeat] Goal done, Prospector! K-S-T-R has your next one.
[bright] Next up from K-S-T-R: pump some silver. Put a Derrick on a well!
[bright, teasing] Next up: spend those skill points. They don't earn interest!
[bright] Next up: sign up at the Citadel. The board has real pay.
[bright] Next up: stock up at the Citadel shop. Before you need it, not after!
[bright, serious] Next up: guard your ore. Set a Gatling Gun by your veins.
[bright] Next up: hire a hand. Mercenaries mine while you sleep!
[warm] Next up: a roof away from home. Raise a Hab Dome out there.
[excited] Level ten! Next up: put something on Q.
[bright] Next up: eyes on the sky. An AA tower keeps the Gloamwings off.
[intrigued] Next up: the Foundry hunt. Find those plans before level fifteen.
[bright] Next up: light the Foundry. One for the whole realm.
[bright] Next up: make a module. The Foundry's warm!
[bright] Next up: raise the Lab. The high marks start there.
[awed] Next up: a dock for ships. The long way out starts here.
[serious, low] Next up: the Matriarch. Bring friends. Bring turrets.
[urgent, breaking news] Bugs in The Fork! Wave incoming, get on those guns!
[relieved, bright] Wave beaten at The Fork. Nice shooting, Prospectors!
[triumphant] The Fork is held! A whole day of peace out there.
[alarmed] The Fork has fallen! The Matriarch is coming for the turrets!
[urgent, breaking news] Bugs in The Drowned Cut! Wave incoming, get on those guns!
[relieved, bright] Wave beaten at The Drowned Cut. Nice shooting, Prospectors!
[triumphant] The Drowned Cut is held! A whole day of peace out there.
[alarmed] The Drowned Cut has fallen! The Matriarch is coming for the turrets!
[urgent, breaking news] Bugs in The Roost! Wave incoming, get on those guns!
[relieved, bright] Wave beaten at The Roost. Nice shooting, Prospectors!
[triumphant] The Roost is held! A whole day of peace out there.
[alarmed] The Roost has fallen! The Matriarch is coming for the turrets!
[bright, proud] The realm lit the Beacon! Dropship flights half price till tomorrow.
[calm] The Beacon is out. Flights are back to full fare.
[bright] The realm raised the Relay! Every pilot sees farther by night till tomorrow.
[calm] The Relay is down. Mind the dark out there.
[bright, fierce] The realm opened the Armoury! Every turret fights a mark up till tomorrow.
[calm] The Armoury is shut. Turrets back to their own marks.
[bright, upbeat] The realm hired a Dock Crew! Mercenaries mine twice as fast till tomorrow.
[calm] The Dock Crew's gone home. Mercenaries back to their own pace.
